Evan — great questions, thanks. Short answers first, then a proposed three-step checklist.

1) API keys: for the evaluation we issue scoped keys per org + ephemeral per-test keys on request. Standard MAP flow: one org-level key for initial integration, then separate environment keys if you request isolation.
2) IP allowlist: yes, we accept CIDR blocks. We ask for the final list 48 hours before the change window; applying rules is usually immediate (no maintenance window) but we recommend a 1-hour verification window for peering and route validation.
3) VPC peering: we support cross-account peering into our customer VPC peer (AWS). Avoid overlapping CIDRs; route propagation is disabled on our side by default, we can enable controlled propagation on request.

Draft checklist below (attached also as PDF):
- Org setup: create org seat (CBH-004) + owner contact (Evan) — marissa to trigger on approval
- API keys: issue org-level key (read/write limited) + generate ephemeral test key on request
- IP allowlist: CBH to populate template with /24s; submit 48h before change window
- VPC peering: exchange account IDs & desired CIDRs; security review by Jonas; establish peering during agreed window
- Validation: smoke tests (token auth, small gen calls, KV cache check) + latency check
- Close timeline: aim to complete by 2026-07-09; if not, contingency target 2026-07-16

I'll attach the MAP v1.0 and allowlist template. Want me to open a HubSpot activity with specific milestones and a DocuSign for SOC addendum?

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

Clara / infra team —

Quick technical confirmations ahead of the 07-06 peering:

- CIDRs: your two /24s (10.12.8.0/24, 10.12.9.0/24) and service /28 (10.12.16.0/28) look good — no overlap with our allocation.
- Route propagation: we'll keep propagation disabled on Redwood side; we expect you to add a static route to your route table for our peer prefix.
- Security groups: please allow outbound TCP/443 to our peered endpoints; we will restrict inbound to only the provided CIDRs.
- Test plan during the 30-min validation: 1) auth test (key + simple generation), 2) small throughput (10 concurrent small gen calls), 3) embeddings vector similarity check.
